builds.summary: First playable proof: time pressure, weight, scarcity and social priority as one decision system.
GameClock, deterministic CrisisTimeline, cancellable ActionTask and exportable RunLog make time itself a social resource.
Directional SocialLedger, evidence-backed promises, refusal, lies and reciprocity make relationships causal rather than decorative.
First complete visual run: variable roster, character-exclusive actions, PRUD/TLAK/MOSTARINA/ZAVODNI BON/BILJEG economy, seven linked scenarios and multiple state-aware endings.
